description: Schedule context for one game: each team's last result, rest, and next game. Facts and our computed context only. Research intelligence (probabilities, factors, context), not winning picks. Price: Free, no signup. Research and information, not betting advice. No outcomes are guaranteed. Adults 21+ only, where legal. Problem gambling help: 1-800-MY-RESET.

harness.description: Optional display hint. It changes the output format only, never access, price or limits.

slug.description: Matchup slug from the daily slate, for example "celtics-at-knicks".

sport.description: Sport. One of nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, cfb, cbb, wnba.

visual.description: Optional. How to present the result: auto (default, chosen by client), image (picture and link), text (terminal chart), none (data only).
